_about: Hand labels for the 50 sampled baseline failures in results/error_sample.jsonl. Read by scripts/06_error_report.py. One primary cause per failure -- the thing that has to be fixed first -- with a note naming the specific mistake. Where a second cause is present it is named in the note rather than double-counted.
_labelled_by: manual review of the question, both queries, and both result sets
battle_death#493: question asks for name, date AND result; gold selects only name and date
car_1#104: joined model_list.ModelId to cars_data.Id; the path runs through car_names.MakeId
car_1#113: car_makers.Country holds a country id, not a name; needs the countries join (literal case is wrong too)
car_1#124: right rows, (CountryId, CountryName) instead of (CountryName, CountryId)
car_1#138: filtered car_names.Make where the value lives in car_names.Model
car_1#148: matched car_makers.Maker (short name, 'amc') against a full name that lives in FullName
car_1#159: compared Accelerate against MAX(Horsepower) instead of the Accelerate of the max-horsepower car
car_1#168: negation inverted: horsepower < MIN(...) instead of > MIN(...)
car_1#94: (Id, FullName, count) instead of (FullName, Id, count)
concert_singer#16: 'the average of all stadiums' -- gold means the Average column, model computed AVG(Capacity)
course_teach#387: gold compares against a lowercased literal that matches nothing, so it returns all 7 rows; the prediction's 6 answers the question
cre_Doc_Template_Mgt#308: looked 'PPT' up as a Template_Type_Description; it is a Template_Type_Code
cre_Doc_Template_Mgt#343: returned the count alongside the template type code
cre_Doc_Template_Mgt#362: SELECT * where the question asks for the details column

dog_kennels#959: gold dedupes arriving/departing date pairs, prediction returns one row per treatment
flight_2#228: gold's OR-join returns 0 rows on this database; nothing non-empty can match it
museum_visit#417: gold is (Num_of_Staff, Open_Year) although the question says 'opening year and staff number'
network_1#900: joined Likes.student_id (the liker) where the question means liked_id (the liked)
orchestra#851: returned the frequency count alongside the record format (sort direction differs too)
pets_1#72: (PetType, avg, max) instead of (avg, max, PetType)
poker_player#675: returned the count alongside the nationality
real_estate_properties#1032: gold dedupes via GROUP BY, prediction returns one row per property
student_transcripts_tracking#529: (semester_id, semester_name) although the question says 'the name and the id'
student_transcripts_tracking#537: returned the student count alongside the program name
student_transcripts_tracking#578: question asks which addresses; gold returns COUNT(DISTINCT current_address_id)

tvshow#637: 'directed by Ben Jones and Michael Chang' read as IN (...), i.e. OR, where gold intersects
voter_1#687: question asks how many states; gold counts area-code rows (305), prediction's COUNT(DISTINCT state) gives 51
world_1#704: LIKE '%republic%' also matches 'Federal Republic', 'Islamic Republic'; gold matches 'Republic' exactly
world_1#723: joined country to city and summed city populations, changing the grain of the answer
world_1#743: returned the language count alongside the continent

world_1#783: NOT LIKE '%Republic%' excludes more than gold's != 'Republic'
world_1#811: gold's own literal 'north america' matches nothing, so both aggregates come back NULL
wta_1#439: 'highest rank' is the smallest rank number; model used MAX
